research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Umoja Biopharma is researching viral particles for activating and transducing immune cells, lentiviral delivery of anti-CD20 and anti-CD19 chimeric antigen receptors, and polycistronic constructs for coexpression of synthetic cytokine receptor complexes and chimeric antigen receptor systems. Additional work includes xenogenic-free methods for generating hematopoietic progenitors and NK cells, engineered stem cells with synthetic cytokine receptors, and the Gated Adaptor Targeting Receptor system. These efforts focus on next-generation immunotherapies for cancer.

overview_description.description: Umoja Biopharma focuses on innovative immunotherapy by reprogramming T cells within the patient's body to target cancer effectively. The company offers scalable therapeutic regimens designed for solid tumors and hematological cancers that typically respond poorly to current treatments. Its in-house CAR T-cell gene therapy platform aims to improve patient outcomes across various stages of cancer.

about_short_description.short_description: Umoja Biopharma is a biopharmaceutical company developing next-generation immunotherapies intended to combat cancer.

product.name: VivoVec Platform
product.description: A lentiviral vector platform designed to generate CAR T cells directly inside a patient’s body after infusion, reducing the time and complexity associated with ex vivo cell manufacturing.

product.name: TumorTag Platform
product.description: A platform of bispecific small-molecule adapters that labels tumor or stromal targets for recognition by universal TagCAR-engineered immune cells.

product.name: RACR Platform
product.description: A rapamycin-activated cytokine receptor system designed to support the expansion, survival, engraftment, and persistence of engineered immune cells.

product.name: UB-VV111
product.description: An investigational VivoVec-based CAR T cell therapy targeting CD19 for hematologic malignancies, including relapsed or refractory B-cell cancers.

product.name: UB-VV500
product.description: An investigational VivoVec-based CAR T cell program targeting BCMA and GPRC5D for multiple myeloma.

product.name: UB-VV400/410
product.description: An investigational VivoVec-driven program targeting CD22 for non-Hodgkin lymphoma and potential autoimmune disease applications.
